correctness.rationale: The five-dimensional free class-three Lie algebra is generated by x,y with derived brackets z=[x,y], u=[x,z], v=[y,z]. Generator images give a unique GL2 times F_q^6 automorphism form; its induced block matrix has diagonal A, det(A), det(A)A. Direct squaring yields A^2=I, C(A+det(A)I)=0, DA+det(A)AD+EC=0 with other blocks automatic. For odd q, A=I has one lift, A=-I has q^2 lifts, and q(q+1) reflections have q^3 lifts each. In char 2, A=I has q^4 lifts and each of the q^2-1 nonidentity unipotent involutions has q^3 lifts. Complete proof and boundaries are in RESULT.md; direct matrix checks over fields of orders 2, 3 and 4 confirmed totals 40, 334 and 1216. Finite checks are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The first rank-two free nilpotent Lie algebra beyond class two has a natural finite-field automorphism group. Counting its square-one elements, with a uniform formula for every field order and a sharp characteristic-two shift caused by nontrivial unipotent linear involutions, distinguishes finite-group structure beyond the automorphism-group order or a single numerical instance. The exact element-order census is useful for automorphism actions and semidirect-product constructions; no downstream theorem or conjugacy classification is claimed.
